facts.fact: Vice President Koung launched the University Innovation Pod-Liberia (UniPod) and reiterated President Boakai's commitment to train 10,000 young Liberians in digital skills through it, with iCampus Liberia, UNDP, the University of Liberia and Orange Digital Center.

facts.fact: The University Innovation Pod-Liberia (UniPod), a makerspace with digital media labs and workstations run by iCampus Liberia with UNDP, was officially launched by Vice President Koung; no incubation cohort is described.
